author: Bobby Grayson
description: Checked Fair.lean SysStepL/SysRun and Supervisor.lean init/beh: init = sup at 0 with [.start], next 1, no timers; run 0 spawns worker 1 with empty mailbox; every SysStepL constructor is then disabled (SysEnabled_iff).
title: SURPRISE: restart_eventually is vacuous as merged. SysRun has only run/signal/down/timer steps (no env, no idle); from Supervisor.init the only step is run 0 on :start, after which nothing is enabled, so no infinite SysRun from init exists and the theorem quantifies over an empty set. The lock is fine: EnvStep (tick p) is always enabled so CRuns from initCfg exist. Fix needed before documenting.
